description: This is a Java unit test class for SecretsAsConfigSupplier, testing its behavior with environment variables, directory contents, and immutability.

classes.name: SecretsAsConfigSupplierTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SecretsAsConfigSupplier, checking immutability, environment variable handling, directory reading, and config generation.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by loading secrets directory URL and initial configuration.

methods.name: setSecretsDirPathEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Sets environment variable for secrets directory path before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that SecretsAsConfigSupplier class and related objects are immutable.

methods.name: useDefaultSecretsDirPathIfNotSetByEnvVariable
methods.description: Checks fallback to default secrets directory path when environment variable is not set.

methods.name: useSecretsDirPathOfSystemEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies that the secrets directory path from environment variable is used.

methods.name: getEmptyConfigForNotExistingDir
methods.description: Ensures empty configuration is returned when secrets directory does not exist.

methods.name: getEmptyConfigForEmptyDir
methods.description: Checks that empty config is returned for an empty secrets directory.

methods.name: getReturnsExpectedSecretsConfig
methods.description: Validates that secrets are correctly loaded into config when secrets exist.
